# Small Business Deadline Calendar (First Mover Projects)

> Dated vendor and system changes that small businesses should check, each linked to the official source. One page per deadline with the date, who it affects, what to check, and a copy-paste checklist prompt. General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice. Always confirm dates on the official source.

Run by First Mover Projects, PO Box 98, Firth, NE 68358. Contact: firstmoverprojects@gmail.com. Not affiliated with any vendor or agency named.

## Deadlines (upcoming)
- [ChatGPT custom GPTs scheduled to retire Dec 11, 2026; affected Enterprise workspaces: new GPT creation ended Oct 26, 2026 (FedRAMP exempt)](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/custom-gpt-retirement-dec-11.html): Anyone who created or relies on a custom GPT; creators can migrate GPTs to plugins. FedRAMP workspaces and affected Enterprise workspaces with a qualifying, approved deferral retire Feb 11, 2027. A deferral alone does not preserve eligibility to create new GPTs. Official source: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001519-custom-gpt-retirement-and-migration-faq
- [Custom GPT Retirement Checker (free, runs in your browser)](https://firstmoverprojects.com/tools/custom-gpt-retirement-checker/): Paste a custom GPT's settings to see which parts need attention before the scheduled Dec 11, 2026 retirement, with a countdown. No sign-up; nothing is sent anywhere.
- [EU product identifiers mandatory for low-value e-commerce imports, Nov 1, 2026](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/eu-product-identifiers-nov-1.html): Sellers outside the EU shipping online orders up to EUR 150 to EU consumers, and whoever declares those parcels. Official source: https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/news/guidance-and-legal-text-temporary-flat-fee-low-value-imports-which-will-apply-until-1-july-2028-2026-06-08_en
- [EU Nov 1 Product ID Quick Check (free, runs in your browser)](https://firstmoverprojects.com/tools/eu-product-id-check/): Paste up to 25 rows of merchant SKU, manufacturer product code and barcode and get a fix list. No sign-up; nothing is sent anywhere.
- [Amazon commercial liability insurance changes, Nov 2, 2026](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/amazon-insurance-nov-2.html): Sellers in categories with enhanced safety listing requirements; sellers based in Mainland China. Official source: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/seller-forums/discussions/t/287d5c33-8278-4802-ba69-2f58f7dda408
- [ZenBusiness Banking closure, deposits stop Nov 3, accounts close Nov 30, 2026](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/zenbusiness-banking-closure.html): ZenBusiness Banking account holders. Official source: https://help.zenbusiness.com/zenbusiness-banking/banking-closure-faq
- [IRS FIRE retirement, last filing day Nov 19, 2026](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/irs-fire-retirement-nov-19.html): Filers who e-file 1099s through FIRE (also Nov 1 test cutoff, Nov 9 TCC change cutoff). Official source: https://www.irs.gov/e-file-providers/filing-information-returns-electronically-fire
- [Amazon Ads older Sponsored Ads and DSP reports pages retire, Dec 31, 2026](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/amazon-ads-legacy-reports-dec-31.html): Amazon advertisers using saved or scheduled reports from the older pages. Official source: https://advertising.amazon.com/resources/whats-new/streamline-campaign-analysis-with-unified-reporting
- [Exchange Online EWS fully and permanently disabled Apr 1, 2027; phased switch-off from Oct 2026](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/exchange-online-ews-retirement-apr-1.html): Microsoft 365 admins whose apps, scripts or services still use EWS. Official source: https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/blog/exchange/exchange-online-ews-your-time-is-almost-up/4492361

## Past
- [Old Microsoft Whiteboards in Azure deleted, Oct 16, 2026 (just passed)](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/whiteboard-azure-oct-16.html): Work or school Whiteboards not migrated to OneDrive. Official source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/whiteboard/migration-of-whiteboards-from-azure-to-onedrive
- [Office 2021 and Windows 11 24H2 Home/Pro updates end, Oct 13, 2026](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/office-2021-windows-11-24h2-oct-13.html): Official source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/system-requirements/end-of-support-for-office-2021

## Free browser tools
- [Etsy Real-Photo & Listing Audit Check](https://firstmoverprojects.com/tools/etsy-photo-audit-check/): Paste up to 10 listing rows, or toggle one listing, and get a current-risk column beside a real-photo fix plan. Runs in the browser. Nothing is uploaded.
- [After-Hours Lead Capture Side-by-Side Scorecard](https://firstmoverprojects.com/tools/after-hours-gap-check/): Six questions plus your own inquiry, ticket, and close-rate numbers. Current setup beside an instant-capture checklist. Arithmetic uses only the numbers you enter.
- [Loom Seat Audit & Creator-Lite Migration Calculator](https://firstmoverprojects.com/tools/loom-seat-audit-calculator/): Paste a seat CSV or enter counts and your per-seat rate. Name and email columns are dropped. Annual arithmetic uses only your counts and rate.
